summary: Pairing checks the gateway's public health node before creating a code, so an unconfigured URL for another member is refused immediately.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: After the existing offline configured-member check, devices pair --gateway anonymously requests the existing /v1/health endpoint beneath the gateway base path. A different node is refused before begin; a matching node continues silently. Unreachable gateways or health responses without a node retain the local-member warning. The three-second timeout bounds reachability only.

manual.detail: If a different gateway member is reported, run the pair command on that member before completing through its gateway.

recovery.detail: Start pairing again on the intended gateway member. A pre-begin refusal creates no pairing code.
